title: JSON schema validation and contract testing

videos.script: A test can check that seats_left is 4. It cannot easily check every field of every answer, every time. {{fields}} A JSON schema can. It is a document that says what a valid answer looks like. Which fields, which types, which values. {{schema}} In this lesson you write two schemas for boxoffice, and check its answers against them with a short Node script. {{ajv}} One of your schemas will be wrong. The API will be right. Telling those two apart is the skill. {{wrong}} Then the same schemas inside Postman and REST Assured. Each tool understands a different version of JSON Schema, and one of them ignores a rule without telling you. {{tools}} Then a question a schema cannot answer. Which fields does each client actually use? {{consumers}} That is consumer-driven contract testing. The Tickets app writes down what it needs, in a pact file, and boxoffice is checked against it. {{pact}} A second client asks for a field boxoffice never had. The check fails on the provider's side, before anything ships. {{fail}} By the end you can say what an answer must look like, and who depends on which part of it.
